# Search protocol v1
The complete authoritative specification is `_STAGE_A_KIT/21_CODEX_ITERATIVE_SEARCH_TASK_EN.md`.
Atomize independently falsifiable behavior across actor, action, object, trigger, modality, scope, exception, timing and severity. Compare semantically against ALL three raw baselines, including policy-linked and dismissed records. Same location may contain distinct clauses. Similarity proposes comparisons only; never proves equivalence. Preserve original labels and run-scoped evidence IDs.
Use source-first discovery, exact newline-normalized quotations, conservative deduplication and auditable stable IDs. Novel does not mean EXTRA or cross-candidate difference. Retain unresolved loading, normativity and equivalence questions.
Run six full-coverage distinct strategy families in specification order, varying candidate/file order; additional adversarial full passes as needed. Every active source file is accounted for each pass, with actual inspected ranges and deferred reasons. Never claim unread ranges were inspected.
Freeze source and baseline hashes; validate at each pass boundary. Checkpoint each meaningful batch atomically where practical. Completed passes remain immutable.
Termination requires all six families and two consecutive different full passes with zero newly verified distinct and zero newly surfaced plausible unresolved claims, plus final unattributed-clause review; unresolved evidence blockers require qualified SEARCH_SATURATED_WITH_OPEN_ISSUES after mandatory searches. No early stopping on one empty pass or token budget. Structural validation cannot prove semantic completeness.
